factual_claims.source_evidence: Revenue Mix Expansion section on page 21 states: 'From a margin perspective, it is critical to highlight that revenue derived from IAA is subject to 0% platform fees, whereas traditional IAP sales remain subject to commission rates of up to 30% from providers such as Google and Apple.'

factual_claims.claim: Marketing expenditure increased 76% to DKK 40.5 million to accelerate user acquisition.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Performance section on page 26 states: 'The marketing budget was expanded to DKK 40,486k (2025), a 76% increase [from DKK 23,019k in 2024], focusing on titles with a projected 6-month payback period.'

factual_claims.claim: The weaker USD affected reported first-half revenue and EBITDA, but management used lower real marketing costs in key territories to increase acquisition spending.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Letter from the CEO on page 5 states: 'The first half of the year was impacted by a weakening USD... The reduced real-cost of marketing spend in key territories allowed us to increase our user acquisition budgets substantially during the period.'

factual_claims.claim: The fourth quarter was the strongest in company history, with revenue up 106% to DKK 41.0 million and EBT up 574% to DKK 10.1 million, despite a 296% increase in quarterly marketing expenditure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Q4 Financial Performance section on page 27 shows: Revenue Q4 2025: DKK 40,959k (106% increase from Q4 2024's DKK 19,924k), EBT Q4 2025: DKK 10,120k (574% increase from Q4 2024's DKK 1,502k), Marketing spend Q4 2025: DKK 9,793k (296% increase from Q4 2024's DKK 2,474k).

factual_claims.claim: Cash declined to DKK 23.0 million, partly reflecting the expanded marketing programme, a DKK 14 million VAT receivable, DKK 4.7 million in repaid tax credits and DKK 4.9 million of share buybacks; cash had recovered to DKK 36.4 million by 31 January 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Liquidity and Working Capital Dynamics section on page 26 states: Cash at bank ended 2025 at DKK 23,049k. Factors included 'the company executed its largest marketing strategy to date... liquidity was temporarily impacted by a substantial increase in other receivables, which rose to DKK 18,645k (2024: DKK 3,326k), specifically including a DKK 14m VAT receivable... the extraordinary DKK 4.7m repayment of tax credits... the completion of the share buy-back program totaling DKK 4,894k... These movements represent a temporary timing effect... Following the year-end collection of receivables and the cash flow from strong December revenue, our cash position improved significantly to DKK 36.4m by 31 January 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: For 2026, management guides for revenue of DKK 130–153 million, EBITDA of DKK 28–36 million and EBT of DKK 18–24 million, while continuing investment in Truck Manager, Farm Manager, Train Manager 2 and Space Manager.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 section on page 10 provides these exact guidance ranges. It also states: 'Our focus is squarely on the product pipeline and leveraging our technological advantage... Production of Train Manager 2 and Space Manager represent a strategic expansion of the ecosystem... Currently consist of four major projects, representing a massive leap in future value.'
